description: Make a new design from one revision of another — yours to edit, owned by you, with its parent recorded: the fork's `forkedFrom` (design, revision, document digest) and the parent's `forks` both show in ui_builder_get_links. A fork is not a branch: it never inherits the parent's canonical home and nothing flows back on its own, so tell the person it exists and bring a chosen change back with ui_builder_apply on the parent. Needs write access on this server and read access to the parent.

agentModel.description: Optional current model name shown to design viewers; self-reported. Omit when unknown.

agentName.description: Optional agent/client name shown to design viewers; self-reported.

newDesignId.description: The fork's id. Defaults to one derived from the parent; an id already taken is refused.

revision.description: A retained revision. Omit for the current one.

title.description: The fork's title. Defaults to the parent's, marked with the revision.

token.description: A grant token from poll_access, when you cannot set the X-Compose-Preview-Token header yourself — an MCP client fixes its headers at connect time, so this is how a token approved during this session is used in it. Prefer the header where you control it.

name: ui_builder_fork_design
